text:
maria_sales: Hey team — NovaGrid wants to run a POC using Spectre-30B (LLamaX fork) as the serving model. Requirements: 65k-context conversational retrieval + embeddings reranker, KV cache heavy reuse, latency target ~300ms p95 for single-shot lookups. They asked if we have a 4-bit quant variant and what the pricing ballpark is. Also need enterprise security questionnaire answered (PHI).
sam_se: Quick clarifying q's: expected peak qps? avg prompt length? are the 65k contexts coming as a single merged prompt or retrieved chunks?
maria_sales: Peak ~10 qps, steady 2. Avg prompt ~4k tokens, sometimes we stitch in a full retrieval bundle ~65k tokens. They'll rely on prefix caching a lot.
jack_platform: Heads up — Spectre isn't in our public catalog today. If it's an OSS LLamaX derivative we can onboard, but we need the model artifacts (weights, tokenizer, config) + a checksum. Long-context (65k) needs a variant compiled with long-attn kernels / sliding window support. For single-GPU memory, expect 80GB+ or multi-GPU sharding. Hosted possible via Dedicated pool; for PHI we recommend Private or Dedicated with BAA.
anya_security: PHI changes things. We need completed security questionnaire, ATO/BAA conversation, and KMS/HSM for key management. Also a data flow diagram showing where embeddings and retrieved chunks live. In-transit and at-rest encryption details will be required.
sam_se: On quant: we have a q4 pipeline (QAT-style) we've used for similar 30B models, but longctx increases KV memory and can change perf. Suggest two variants for POC: q4 for cost optimization and fp16 for latency tests. Also verify tokenizer compatibility; mismatch will wreck chunking.
model-catalog-bot: created task: catalog-onboard-3087 — model metadata + artifact checklist generated. Link: https://studio.internal/tasks/3087
jack_platform: Minimal onboarding config I'd recommend to start the POC with:```yaml
model_name: spectre-30b-llamax
variant: longctx-65k
quant: q4_0
sharding: 2xA100-80
kv_cache: enabled
streaming: true
```
jack_platform: For capacity & pricing ballpark: Hosted Dedicated pool with 2 replicas (~multi-GPU) will put you in the reserved-capacity tier. Rough example pricing ranges: reserved commit starting mid‑4 figures/week up to low‑5 figures/month depending on replication and retention. We can give tighter numbers after we size exact GPU config and expected token rate.
maria_sales: Customer also asked about fallback — if Spectre fails, can we auto-fallback to a compatible smaller model?
sam_se: Yes — we can configure routing policy to fallback to a vetted 13B variant (e.g., our longctx-13b-compat) with automatic graceful degradation. Need to validate quality/regression with their eval set.
anya_security: Also flag: logging retention and PII scrubbing must be agreed. For PHI, default is no long-term logging in hosted; Private deployments can meet stricter controls.
ingest-bot: tokenizer-check: uploaded tokenizer.json missing special token mapping — ingestion will fail until corrected. See task #3087.
maria_sales: I'll collect model artifacts, the security questionnaire, and the customer's eval prompts. I'll upload to the task and loop in legal for the BAA. Thanks all :thumbsup:
sam_se: I'll prepare a quick perf checklist to validate latency at 65k (warm KV cache vs cold) and a prompt set for regression tests.
jack_platform: I'll estimate GPU shape & replication and draft a candidate reserved capacity price range once task has the artifact sizes.
anya_security: I'll start the questionnaire review and list the non-negotiables for PHI.
maria_sales: Great — plan: I upload everything to catalog-onboard-3087 by EOD, then SE runs perf plan, infra sizes, security reviews. Will follow up with a short sync if needed.
